subject: 0.8.3 nested facet glitch, Mac OS X?

messages.author: fa5075172bd9cc4c
messages.subject: 0.8.3 nested facet glitch, Mac OS X?
parts:
Hi, my old ggplot2 was way out of date, when I installed the latest R
and ggplot2 on Mac OS X the facet nesting became unhappy about
something ... here's an example from the facet_grid help page run in a
fresh R session immediately after library(ggplot2)

> qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = . ~ vs + am)
Error in cbind("spacer", c("strip_h", "strip_h", "strip_h",
"strip_h", :
number of rows of matrices must match (see arg 2)

Same message for other data sets and calls to facet_grid directly. The
required packages ggplot2, grid, plyr, proto and reshape (*** below)
were loaded and are latest versions. testInstalledPackage() succeeded
for each of them so it appears to be a clean install.

Any thoughts or suggestions would be most appreciated. Thanks.

- Tom
